title: Exception handling and avoiding double barring

entities.name: Access control exception for double barring avoidance
entities.description: Allows access attempts to proceed without further access control checking to avoid double barring, applicable during NAS signalling connection recovery or after fallback indication from lower layers.

entities.name: Emergency service
entities.description: Service triggered by upper layer request for emergency registration or PDU session establishment with emergency request types. Considered ongoing until the emergency PDU session is released.

entities.name: MMTEL voice call
entities.description: Ongoing MMTEL voice call service that affects access category mapping and access control exceptions.

entities.name: MMTEL video call
entities.description: Ongoing MMTEL video call service that affects access category mapping and access control exceptions when no voice call is ongoing.

entities.name: SMS over NAS
entities.description: SMS service over NAS that affects access category mapping and access control exceptions.

entities.name: SMS over IP
entities.description: SMS over IP service that affects access category mapping and access control exceptions.

entities.name: MO IMS registration related signalling
entities.description: Mobile originated IMS registration signalling that affects access category mapping and access control exceptions.

entities.name: Access category 2
entities.description: Emergency access category used for mapping access attempts during ongoing emergency services.

entities.name: Access category 4
entities.description: Access category used for MMTEL voice call related access attempts.

entities.name: Access category 5
entities.description: Access category used for MMTEL video call related access attempts when no voice call is ongoing.

entities.name: Access category 6
entities.description: Access category used for SMSoIP related access attempts when no MMTEL calls are ongoing.

entities.name: Access category 9
entities.description: Access category used for MO IMS registration related signalling when no other higher priority services are ongoing.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: NAS procedure initiated for service requests, which may be subject to access control exceptions and category mapping.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: NAS procedure for registration, which may be subject to access control exceptions.

relations.description: Service request procedures are allowed without access control checking when double barring avoidance condition applies.
Registration procedures are allowed without access control checking when double barring avoidance condition applies.
Ongoing emergency service causes access attempts to be mapped to access category 2.
Ongoing MMTEL voice call causes IMS-related access attempts to be mapped to access category 4.
Ongoing MMTEL video call (with no voice call) causes IMS-related access attempts to be mapped to access category 5.
Ongoing SMSoIP (with no MMTEL calls) causes IMS-related access attempts to be mapped to access category 6.
Ongoing MO IMS registration signalling (with no higher priority services) causes access attempts to be mapped to access category 9.
Ongoing emergency service triggers access control exception for related service requests and uplink data.
Ongoing SMS over NAS service can trigger access control exceptions for certain access attempts.
